resources.string: Native WFZ renderer for selected Stratos/Pace elements and simple Stratos 3 components. Import a .wfz file and check the report before enabling it. Unknown widgets and animations are omitted; system widgets may use a plain text replacement. BIN, Zepp OS and APK watchfaces are not supported. Seconds are off by default.
Import again to generate a compatibility report
Report from an older renderer. Import again to update the compatibility details.
Health values need Health Connect, your permission and available data. Otherwise the fields show --.
The battery display uses your phone battery.
Amazfit watch connection indicators are not displayed.
Weather fields show -- because weather data is unavailable.
Workout distance and floor count fields show -- because their data is unavailable.
Some selectable widgets use replacement fonts or icons and may look different.
Weekday labels use the English images supplied by the watchface.
Battery images are assigned proportionally to the charge level and may differ from the original.
Some extra images or image overlays cannot be displayed.
Some date formatting options are not applied. Check the date in the preview.
Some layout options are not applied. Check positions and overlaps in the preview.
Some elements or selectable widgets cannot be displayed. Check the preview.
